description: The base every zachthedev repository takes, through one kind preset beside this file. A repository's renovate.json extends the kind and adds only what is true of that repository alone.

No Renovate default is restated here. Renovate's own values give internalChecksFilter strict, minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour timestamp-required, semanticCommitType chore and semanticCommitScope deps. They also give prConcurrentLimit 10, automerge off, and a vulnerabilityAlerts object with an empty schedule and a null cooldown.
The Monday window below contains the daily cron in the caller's deps workflow. A window the cron never lands inside opens nothing new. Renovate's own weekly presets close at 04:00, before that cron.

Security fixes come from the repository's Dependabot alerts and skip the schedule and the cooldown. enabled is written out because it lets an alert force a disabled dependency, such as an indirect Go module, back on for that fix. Renovate matches an alert to a dependency it extracted. A direct dependency gets a pull request, a Go transitive gets one through its go.mod line, and a Bun, Cargo or NuGet transitive gets none.

customManagers.description: trufflesecurity/trufflehog's version input is the image tag and digest the action runs, which the github-actions manager does not read. Looked up on Docker Hub for its timestamp; the action pulls the same digest from ghcr.io.

packageRules.description: One pull request per ecosystem for minor and patch bumps. A major stays on its own branch, because it is a decision, not a bump.
A workflow change is a ci commit, whatever it pins.
A zachthedev repository is the author's own work, so a new tag of it waits for nothing. The shared workflows reach every caller on the next run.
One pull request whatever the bump size: the action and the image it runs carry the same release line.
